objectives.sli: valid production API requests served without a service-attributable 5xx or timeout divided by all valid production API requests
p95 server duration for the explicitly enumerated synchronous production API operations
elapsed time from declared service disaster to restoration of the supported production profile
maximum age of committed customer state unavailable after a verified restore
durably acknowledged customer records recoverable with authenticated integrity after a verified restore
elapsed time from accepted severity-one support incident to qualified human acknowledgement
age of the newest independently retained authenticated audit-chain checkpoint

limitations: No target in this draft is an availability, latency, recovery, durability, support, or audit-anchor commitment.
The single-control-plane profile is not high availability and requires measured restore and failover drills before approval.
Fixture tests, local regressions, and repository proof packs are not measurements for these service objectives.
